title: How a 700 MB CD Holds an Entire Album—and a Game

scenes.text: A standard 120 mm CD stores exactly 700 megabytes of data
Data is encoded as 1.2‑micron pits spaced 0.83 microns apart on the disc surface
A 650‑MB CD spins at 200–500 rpm, letting the laser read 150 KB per second
scenes.query: CD read speed 150 KB per second
scenes.query2: CD data transfer rate 150 kilobytes per second

scenes.text: That’s why classic PC games could fit on one disc, making distribution cheap and reliable

description: Ever wonder how a tiny disc can hold a full soundtrack and a game? Learn the exact physics behind CD storage. Follow for more tech made simple.
